title: Shoulder Self-Massage
summary: One hand gently kneads the opposite upper shoulder with a broad grip.
goal: Work the upper trapezius gently on yourself.
startingPosition: Sit comfortably and lower the shoulders.
instructions: Place one hand on the opposite shoulder.
Do not move onto the side of the neck.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
